summary: Post-CORS-change auth regression smoke test (frontend only). Admin & salesman login, protected route navigation, refresh persistence, logout & redirect all verified working. No CORS or unexpected 401 errors observed.

test_details.admin_login: PASS - sales@dbgsigns.com logged in, landed on /dashboard, saw 370 Customers / 21 Materials / 0 invoices (data loaded, no 401/CORS).
test_details.cookies_set: access_token & refresh_token both httpOnly=true, secure=true, sameSite=None. Correct for cross-site credentialed auth.
test_details.protected_routes: /invoices, /customers, /reports all loaded with zero API errors while authenticated.
test_details.session_persistence: Reload on /customers kept user authenticated (no redirect to /login, no API errors).
test_details.logout: 'Sign out' button worked; /customers after logout redirected to /login.
test_details.salesman_login: sam@dbgsigns.com logged in, landed on /estimates with 'Welcome, Sam Salesman' toast; no 401/CORS errors during login or navigation.
test_details.cors_console_errors: None. No cross-origin / CORS messages in browser console.
test_details.expected_401s: Initial /api/auth/me call before login and after logout returns 401 (expected auth-check behavior, not a regression).

test_credentials: Admin sales@dbgsigns.com / 10297099; Salesman sam@dbgsigns.com / Sales2026! - both valid
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS middleware change (regex + credentials) is safe; auth cookies flow works end-to-end same-origin. If deploying cross-origin, verify browser accepts SameSite=None cookies and that allow_origin_regex reflects the actual frontend host.
